trigger_condition: Tool-call path raises TokenLimitExceededException, caught by invoke_task's except Exception
potential_consequence: Failed TaskResult reports truncated=False despite the failure being a real truncation
FAILED state persisted with no finish_reason/truncated even though tool-call truncation caused the failure

trigger_condition: Terminal message has non-empty content and a truncating finish/stop reason simultaneously (e.g. non-streaming LLM call)
potential_consequence: is_valid_ai_message branch wins, _detect_terminal_truncation never runs, truncation silently missed

trigger_condition: Same non-empty-content+truncated-metadata race in the supervisor/multi-agent path
guard_snippet: check is_finish_reason_truncated before/independent of the is_valid_ai_message streaming branch
potential_consequence: Supervisor sub-agent truncation goes undetected when content isn't empty

trigger_condition: An earlier terminal message in the same invoke_task call is truncated, a later one in the same run completes normally (finish_reason=stop)
guard_snippet: else: self._last_finish_reason = None; self._last_truncated = False  # on non-matching finish_reason
potential_consequence: Stale truncated=True/finish_reason from an earlier turn leaks into the final TaskResult of a successfully completed run

trigger_condition: invoke_task invoked concurrently on the same LangGraphAgent instance (concurrent-invocation lock was removed)
guard_snippet: store finish_reason/truncated on a per-call-local object instead of shared self._last_* instance attributes
potential_consequence: Concurrent requests race on shared mutable state, cross-contaminating each other's truncated/finish_reason result

trigger_condition: Legacy AssistantAgent.invoke_task (non-LangGraph) calls from_agent_response/failed_result without finish_reason/truncated
guard_snippet: detect truncation from response/exception here too and pass finish_reason=..., truncated=... into TaskResult
potential_consequence: Nodes driven by AssistantAgent always report truncated=False even when the LLM response was actually cut off

trigger_condition: Overall WorkflowExecution model / WorkflowExecutionResponse never receives finish_reason/truncated from the finishing state
guard_snippet: add finish_reason/truncated to WorkflowExecution and set them in finish() from the last state
potential_consequence: Main execution-status endpoint (WorkflowExecutionResponse) never surfaces truncation; only the per-state output endpoint does

trigger_condition: Provider signals truncation with a value other than finish_reason in (length,max_tokens) or stop/stopReason==max_tokens (e.g. Gemini MAX_TOKENS)
guard_snippet: extend the recognized finish/stop reason set per provider or normalize before comparing
potential_consequence: Truncated responses from unlisted providers are silently reported as truncated=False
